Payload.$Comment: Keeps every mob Mob Scaling scales in the Shifting Deep's tier 3 (MMO Skill Tree's dungeon Shifting_Deep_Tier_3) between level 30 and level 45. Each copy is a world named after the dungeon's file, a dash and the copy's number (shifting_deep_tier_3-1 and so on), so this pattern reaches tier 3's copies alone. Floor is the level a mob's health and damage come from, since a dungeon copy has no zone or biome; a nearby group's power raises the level its rarity, affixes and casters roll at, and MinCap and MaxCap clamp that. DistanceEscalation is off and PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is 0, as in every dungeon band. To move the band, set Floor and MinCap to the new bottom and MaxCap to the new top; add "Enabled": false to switch scaling off in this tier entirely. Party is off: the dungeon already brings more foes for a bigger party, so its mobs do not also grow tougher with the players near them.
